$comentario: APLICADO el 2026-11-08 (ruleset a7eac2de4f62405c978e90a8c40d30f9). Reglas WAF personalizadas (fase http_request_firewall_custom). Validado con --validate-only. Ver docs/security/waf-rules.md.
name: default

rules.description: 1. Bloquear archivos ocultos, copias y configuraciones
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/." and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known/")) or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".env") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".bak") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".backup") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".old") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".orig") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".save") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".swp") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".sql") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".sqlite") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".db") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".log") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".ini") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".conf") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".cfg") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".yml") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".yaml") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".toml") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".lock") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".pem") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".key") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".crt") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".p12") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".pfx") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".zip") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".tar") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".gz") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".tgz") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".7z") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".rar")

rules.description: 2. Bloquear sondeos de tecnologías que el sitio no usa
rules.expression: ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".php") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".php5") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".phtml") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".asp") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".aspx") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".jsp") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".cgi") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".pl") or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php/" or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wordpress") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/xmlrpc") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/phpmyadmin") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/pma/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/cgi-bin/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/vendor/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/administrator/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/actuator") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/owa/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/autodiscover/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/boaform/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/hnap1") or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/wp-admin" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/wp-content/" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/wp-includes/"

rules.description: 3. Solo GET y HEAD, salvo POST del mismo origen al formulario
rules.expression: (starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/api/") or not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) and not (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/consulta" and http.request.method eq "POST" and any(http.request.headers["origin"][*] eq "https://evelynelizondo.com"))
